facts.text: The upstream driver class is HP89400Device, a PrologixGPIBEthernetDevice
The class constructor forwards its arguments to PrologixGPIBEthernetDevice
The README describes the package as HP89400 Series Vector Signal Analyzer GPIB Control using the Prologix GPIB-ETHERNET adapter
GetXCenter queries SENS:FREQ:CENT? and GetXSpan queries SENS:FREQ:SPAN?
GetXUnits queries CALC:X:UNIT:FREQ? and GetYUnits queries CALC:UNIT:POW?
GetDataLength queries CALC:DATA:HEAD:POIN? and returns an int
GetReadDataPoints queries SENS:AVER:COUN:INT? and returns an int
get_operating_condition queries STAT:OPER:COND? and returns an int
get_error_code takes the leading comma-separated field of an error string as an int
read_errors queries SYST:ERR?, and read_error_code returns get_error_code(read_errors())
read_data starts a data read with StartDataRead and parses the comma-separated reply into floats
abort writes abor until the write succeeds
enable_autorange writes SENS:VOLT:RANGE:AUTO with an integer 0/1 setting
The README's sample capture shows a 5 MHz span centred at 2.5 MHz with 1601 points, X unit HZ and Y unit VRMS/RTHZ
The README states that no x values are saved, only y values, and that the x values can be determined from the header
